title: Who holds the land
text: More than half of McKinley County is tribal land, as of 2024. Navajo Nation lands cover more than two fifths of the county, and the Zuni Reservation nearly a tenth. The Bureau of Land Management manages about 7 percent, the Cibola National Forest about 6, and state trust land about 5.
